name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Filled upper lobes and center notch are fitted to the visible exterior of the original Outline at Regular stroke 1.70 (0.85-unit outward normal offset). Offset branches are trimmed at the symmetric center intersection, with cubic segments fitted to within 0.001 drawing unit. The lower slim V and slight outward bow remain as authored. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Not owner-approved.
